package bouncer

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/avl/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/urequire/v0"
)

var (
	adminAddr = testutils.TestAddress("admin")
	botAddr   = testutils.TestAddress("bot")
	alice     = testutils.TestAddress("alice")
	bob       = testutils.TestAddress("bob")
)

// reset gives each test fresh state with a known admin.
func reset() {
	admin = adminAddr
	attesters = avl.NewTree()
	attesters.Set(string(adminAddr), true)
	requests = avl.NewTree()
	openByRequester = avl.NewTree()
	openRequests = avl.NewTree()
	records = avl.NewTree()
	byAuthor = avl.NewTree()
	disputes = avl.NewTree()
	recent = nil
	totalFindings, totalProven = 0, 0
}

// testing.SetRealm applies to the frame that calls it, so it is called
// inline right before each crossing call, never from a helper.

func hash(c string) string { return strings.Repeat(c, 64) }

// attest posts an attestation as the bot (which must be an attester).
func attest(cur realm, pkgpath, report, findings string, unverified int) {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(botAddr))
	Attest(cross(cur), pkgpath, hash("a"), "0.1.0", hash("b"), "master.1+f0f9c70", report, "ipfs://bafyexample", findings, 0, 0, unverified)
}

func addBot(cur realm) {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(adminAddr))
	AddAttester(cross(cur), botAddr)
}

func TestScoreFormula(t *testing.T) {
	f := func(rule, sev, label string) Finding {
		return Finding{Rule: rule, Severity: sev, Label: label, File: "a.gno", Line: 1}
	}
	cases := []struct {
		name    string
		fs      []Finding
		deps    Deps
		score   int
		grade   string
		verdict string
	}{
		{"clean", nil, Deps{}, 100, "A", VerdictClear},
		{"proven critical", []Finding{f("B05", SeverityCritical, LabelProven)}, Deps{}, 60, "C", VerdictNotRecommended},
		{"proven high", []Finding{f("B01", SeverityHigh, LabelProven)}, Deps{}, 75, "B", VerdictNotRecommended},
		{"high warning", []Finding{f("B01", SeverityHigh, LabelNotReproduced)}, Deps{}, 90, "A", VerdictReview},
		{"critical static warning", []Finding{f("B03", SeverityCritical, LabelStaticWarning)}, Deps{}, 85, "B", VerdictReview},
		{"medium only", []Finding{f("B04", SeverityMedium, LabelStaticWarning)}, Deps{}, 95, "A", VerdictClear},
		{"mixed with deps", []Finding{
			f("B05", SeverityCritical, LabelProven),      // 40
			f("B01", SeverityHigh, LabelNotReproduced),   // 10
			f("B04", SeverityMedium, LabelStaticWarning), // 5
		}, Deps{DirectAtRisk: 1, IndirectAtRisk: 1, Unverified: 1}, 28, "F", VerdictNotRecommended}, // 100-55-10-5-2
		{"unverified capped at 10", nil, Deps{Unverified: 7}, 90, "A", VerdictClear},
		{"floor at zero", []Finding{
			f("B05", SeverityCritical, LabelProven),
			f("B05", SeverityCritical, LabelProven),
			f("B05", SeverityCritical, LabelProven),
		}, Deps{}, 0, "F", VerdictNotRecommended},
		{"grade D", []Finding{f("B01", SeverityHigh, LabelProven), f("B01", SeverityHigh, LabelProven), f("B04", SeverityMedium, LabelStaticWarning)}, Deps{}, 45, "D", VerdictNotRecommended},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		score, grade, verdict := ScoreFor(c.fs, c.deps)
		if score != c.score || grade != c.grade || verdict != c.verdict {
			t.Errorf("%s: got %d %s %s, want %d %s %s", c.name, score, grade, verdict, c.score, c.grade, c.verdict)
		}
	}
}

func TestRequestScan(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	id1 := RequestScan(cross(cur), "gno.land/r/demo/vault")
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "you already have an open scan request", func() {
		RequestScan(cross(cur), "gno.land/r/demo/other")
	})
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "invalid package path", func() {
		RequestScan(cross(cur), "gno.land/r/Demo/../x")
	})
	id2 := RequestScan(cross(cur), "gno.land/r/demo/token")

	open := OpenRequests(10)
	urequire.Equal(t, 2, len(open))
	uassert.Equal(t, id1, open[0].ID)
	uassert.Equal(t, id2, open[1].ID)
	uassert.Equal(t, alice, open[0].Requester)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, len(OpenRequests(1)))

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	CancelRequest(cross(cur))
	r, ok := GetRequest(id1)
	uassert.True(t, ok)
	uassert.Equal(t, "cancelled", r.Status)
	RequestScan(cross(cur), "gno.land/r/demo/other") // allowed again
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, len(OpenRequests(10)))
}

func TestAttest(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	reqID := RequestScan(cross(cur), "gno.land/r/demo/vault")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "attester only", func() {
		Attest(cross(cur), "gno.land/r/demo/vault", hash("a"), "0.1.0", hash("b"), "x", hash("c"), "ipfs://cid", "", 0, 0, 0)
	})
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "admin only", func() { AddAttester(cross(cur), bob) })
	addBot(cur)

	attest(cur, "gno.land/r/demo/vault", hash("c"), "B01,high,PROVEN,vault.gno,64;B05,critical,PROVEN,vault.gno,35", 0)
	a, ok := Latest("gno.land/r/demo/vault")
	urequire.True(t, ok)
	uassert.Equal(t, 35, a.Score) // 100 - 25 - 40
	uassert.Equal(t, "F", a.Grade)
	uassert.Equal(t, VerdictNotRecommended, a.Verdict)
	uassert.Equal(t, botAddr, a.Attester)
	urequire.Equal(t, 2, len(a.Findings))
	uassert.Equal(t, 64, a.Findings[0].Line)

	r, _ := GetRequest(reqID)
	uassert.Equal(t, "attested", r.Status)
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, len(OpenRequests(10)))
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, totalFindings)
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, totalProven)

	// A re-scan replaces the totals for that package.
	attest(cur, "gno.land/r/demo/vault", hash("d"), "", 0)
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, totalFindings)
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, len(History("gno.land/r/demo/vault")))
	s, _ := Score("gno.land/r/demo/vault")
	uassert.Equal(t, 100, s)
}

func TestAttestRejectsBadInput(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	addBot(cur)
	bad := []struct {
		msg                                    string
		pkg, src, report, uri, findings, scanv string
	}{
		{"invalid package path", "vault", hash("a"), hash("c"), "ipfs://x", "", "0.1.0"},
		{"hashes must be 64 lowercase hex characters", "gno.land/r/demo/v", "abc", hash("c"), "ipfs://x", "", "0.1.0"},
		{"hashes must be 64 lowercase hex characters", "gno.land/r/demo/v", hash("A"), hash("c"), "ipfs://x", "", "0.1.0"},
		{"report URI must be ipfs://<cid> or an https:// URL", "gno.land/r/demo/v", hash("a"), hash("c"), "javascript:alert(1)", "", "0.1.0"},
		{"report URI must be ipfs://<cid> or an https:// URL", "gno.land/r/demo/v", hash("a"), hash("c"), "https://x.io/a)b", "", "0.1.0"},
		{"invalid label: SAFE", "gno.land/r/demo/v", hash("a"), hash("c"), "ipfs://x", "B01,high,SAFE,a.gno,1", "0.1.0"},
		{"invalid file name: ../a.gno", "gno.land/r/demo/v", hash("a"), hash("c"), "ipfs://x", "B01,high,PROVEN,../a.gno,1", "0.1.0"},
		{"invalid rule id: X1", "gno.land/r/demo/v", hash("a"), hash("c"), "ipfs://x", "X1,high,PROVEN,a.gno,1", "0.1.0"},
		{"invalid line: 0", "gno.land/r/demo/v", hash("a"), hash("c"), "ipfs://x", "B01,high,PROVEN,a.gno,0", "0.1.0"},
		{"invalid scanner or toolchain version", "gno.land/r/demo/v", hash("a"), hash("c"), "ipfs://x", "", "0.1 0"},
	}
	for _, b := range bad {
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(botAddr))
		uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, b.msg, func() {
			Attest(cross(cur), b.pkg, b.src, b.scanv, hash("b"), "gno", b.report, b.uri, b.findings, 0, 0, 0)
		})
	}
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, records.Size())
}

func TestReadsReturnCopies(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	addBot(cur)
	attest(cur, "gno.land/r/demo/vault", hash("c"), "B01,high,PROVEN,vault.gno,64", 0)
	a, _ := Latest("gno.land/r/demo/vault")
	a.Findings[0].Rule = "B99"
	a.Score = 100
	h := History("gno.land/r/demo/vault")
	h[0].Findings[0].Line = 1
	again, _ := Latest("gno.land/r/demo/vault")
	uassert.Equal(t, "B01", again.Findings[0].Rule)
	uassert.Equal(t, 64, again.Findings[0].Line)
	uassert.Equal(t, 75, again.Score)
}

func TestDispute(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	addBot(cur)
	pkg := "gno.land/r/demo/clean"
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "no attestation to dispute", func() { Dispute(cross(cur), pkg, hash("e"), "x") })

	attest(cur, pkg, hash("c"), "", 0)
	uassert.True(t, Check(pkg, Strict()))

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "a dispute needs a report that differs from the attested one", func() {
		Dispute(cross(cur), pkg, hash("c"), "same report")
	})
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	id := Dispute(cross(cur), pkg, hash("e"), "my run finds B01 at vault.gno:12")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "you already have an open dispute on this package", func() {
		Dispute(cross(cur), pkg, hash("f"), "again")
	})
	uassert.False(t, Check(pkg, Strict()))  // open dispute
	uassert.True(t, Check(pkg, Standard())) // Standard tolerates disputes

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "admin or attester only", func() { ResolveDispute(cross(cur), id, "no") })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(botAddr))
	ResolveDispute(cross(cur), id, "re-ran with 0.1.1: no B01")
	uassert.True(t, Check(pkg, Strict()))
	ds := DisputesFor(pkg)
	urequire.Equal(t, 1, len(ds))
	uassert.True(t, ds[0].Resolved)
}

func TestReply(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	addBot(cur)
	v1 := "gno.land/r/" + alice.String() + "/vault/v1"
	v2 := "gno.land/r/" + alice.String() + "/vault/v2"
	attest(cur, v1, hash("c"), "B01,high,PROVEN,vault.gno,64", 0)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, len(ByAuthor(alice)))

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "author only", func() { Reply(cross(cur), v1, "not me", "") })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "the successor must be in the same address namespace", func() {
		Reply(cross(cur), v1, "moved", "gno.land/r/"+bob.String()+"/vault/v2")
	})
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	Reply(cross(cur), v1, "Fixed in v2: getters return copies.", v2)
	rs := Replies(v1)
	urequire.Equal(t, 1, len(rs))
	uassert.Equal(t, v2, rs[0].Successor)

	attest(cur, "gno.land/r/demo/shared", hash("c"), "", 0)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "only address-namespace packages have a verified author", func() {
		Reply(cross(cur), "gno.land/r/demo/shared", "mine", "")
	})
}

func TestCheckPolicies(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	addBot(cur)
	attest(cur, "gno.land/r/demo/clean", hash("c"), "", 0)
	attest(cur, "gno.land/r/demo/warn", hash("c"), "B01,high,NOT REPRODUCED,a.gno,3", 0)
	attest(cur, "gno.land/r/demo/high", hash("c"), "B01,high,PROVEN,a.gno,3", 0)
	attest(cur, "gno.land/r/demo/crit", hash("c"), "B05,critical,PROVEN,a.gno,3", 0)
	attest(cur, "gno.land/r/demo/deps", hash("c"), "", 1)

	cases := []struct {
		pkg              string
		strict, standard bool
	}{
		{"gno.land/r/demo/clean", true, true},
		{"gno.land/r/demo/warn", true, true},  // 90, warnings only
		{"gno.land/r/demo/high", false, true}, // 75, PROVEN High
		{"gno.land/r/demo/crit", false, false},
		{"gno.land/r/demo/deps", false, true}, // unverified dependency
		{"gno.land/r/demo/unknown", false, false},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		uassert.Equal(t, c.strict, Check(c.pkg, Strict()), c.pkg+" strict")
		uassert.Equal(t, c.standard, Check(c.pkg, Standard()), c.pkg+" standard")
	}
	custom := Custom(50).WithProvenCritical()
	uassert.True(t, Check("gno.land/r/demo/crit", custom))
	uassert.False(t, Check("gno.land/r/demo/high", custom)) // PROVEN High not allowed
}

func TestAdminTransfer(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(adminAddr))
	TransferAdmin(cross(cur), alice)
	uassert.Equal(t, alice, Admin())
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(adminAddr))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "admin only", func() { AddAttester(cross(cur), bob) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	AddAttester(cross(cur), bob)
	uassert.True(t, IsAttester(bob))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	RemoveAttester(cross(cur), bob)
	uassert.False(t, IsAttester(bob))
}

func TestRender(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	addBot(cur)
	v1 := "gno.land/r/" + alice.String() + "/vault/v1"
	attest(cur, v1, hash("c"), "B01,high,PROVEN,vault.gno,64;B05,critical,PROVEN,vault.gno,35", 0)
	attest(cur, v1, hash("d"), "B05,critical,PROVEN,vault.gno,35", 0)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	Reply(cross(cur), v1, "fixed [x](javascript:alert(1)) <script>alert(1)</script> | col", "gno.land/r/"+alice.String()+"/vault/v2")

	home := Render("")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, `<gno-form exec="RequestScan">`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, Disclaimer))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "/bouncer/v0:realm/"+v1))

	page := Render("realm/" + v1)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "## 60 / 100 · Grade C · 🔴 Not recommended for integration"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, Disclaimer))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "| B05 | critical | **PROVEN** |"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "B01 resolved"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "https://ipfs.filebase.io/ipfs/bafyexample"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "The author points to a newer version"))
	// User text is escaped: no live link, no raw HTML.
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(page, "](javascript:"))
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(page, "<script>"))

	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("realm/gno.land/r/demo/none"), "has not attested this package yet"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("realm/not a path"), "not a valid package path"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("nope"), "# Not found"))
}

	}

package lastorders

import (
	"chain"
	"chain/banker"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
	"gno.land/r/g1zjumaghw5cgzhyj46eygvd452p6the6n56dppx/lamplighter/registry/v2"
)

const selfPath = "gno.land/r/g1zjumaghw5cgzhyj46eygvd452p6the6n56dppx/lamplighter/lastorders/v1"

var (
	selfAddr = chain.PackageAddress(selfPath)
	seller   = testutils.TestAddress("seller")
	ann      = testutils.TestAddress("ann")
	ben      = testutils.TestAddress("ben")
	lighter  = testutils.TestAddress("lighter")
)

func ugnotOf(addr address) int64 {
	return banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(addr, denom)
}

// sending attaches coins to the next call into this realm. The test banker
// does not move those coins by itself, so they are issued to the realm.
//
// Two things have to stay in the test function itself, because the test
// runtime ties them to its call frame: choosing who is calling
// (testing.SetRealm), and the call that is meant to be a direct one.
func sending(amount int64) {
	coins := chain.Coins{{denom, amount}}
	testing.IssueCoins(selfAddr, coins)
	testing.SetOriginSend(coins)
}

// Every test settles the rounds it opens, so that no coins are owed across
// test functions: the test runtime empties all balances between them.

// The whole flow: a round is opened and funds its own job, two bidders
// compete, and a stranger running the job at closing time moves the money.
func TestALamplighterSettlesTheRound(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(seller))
	sending(LampFee)
	id := Open(cross(cur), "Friday's last round", 300)
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)

	job := JobOf(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, selfPath, registry.Owner(job))
	uassert.Equal(t, LampFee, registry.Balance(job), "the realm funded its own job from the seller's fee")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), ugnotOf(selfAddr), "the fee went to the registry, not into this realm")
	uassert.False(t, registry.IsDue(job))

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(ann))
	sending(100000)
	Bid(cross(cur), id, "To absent friends")
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)

	annBefore := ugnotOf(ann)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(ben))
	sending(105000)
	Bid(cross(cur), id, "To the lamplighters")
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.Equal(t, annBefore+100000, ugnotOf(ann), "the outbid bidder is refunded at once")
	leader, bid := Leader(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, ben, leader)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(105000), bid)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render(""), "## Open rounds"))

	// Nothing can settle it early.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(lighter))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "job is not due yet", func() { registry.Exec(cross(cur), job) })

	testing.SkipHeights(61) // 305s: past closing time
	uassert.True(t, registry.IsDue(job))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render(""), "to settle it"))

	sellerBefore, lighterBefore := ugnotOf(seller), ugnotOf(lighter)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(lighter))
	registry.Exec(cross(cur), job)

	uassert.True(t, Settled(id))
	uassert.Equal(t, sellerBefore+105000, ugnotOf(seller), "the winning bid reaches the seller")
	uassert.Equal(t, lighterBefore+LampFee, ugnotOf(lighter), "the lamplighter is paid the fee")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), ugnotOf(selfAddr), "nothing is left behind")
	uassert.True(t, registry.Done(job), "the job is done and waits for its owner to clean it up")

	page := Render("")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "## The wall"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "To the lamplighters"))

	// The seller frees the finished job, which is what releases the storage
	// deposit that opening the round locked. Nobody else can.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(ann))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "only the seller can reclaim the deposit of a round", func() { Reclaim(cross(cur), id) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(seller))
	Reclaim(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.False(t, registry.Exists(job))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "already reclaimed", func() { Reclaim(cross(cur), id) })
}

func TestOpenAndBidRules(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(seller))
	sending(LampFee)
	id := Open(cross(cur), "Rules", 300)
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(ann))
	sending(200000)
	Bid(cross(cur), id, "First")
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)

	// 5% over 200000, rounded up, is the least the next bid may be.
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(210000), minNextBid(mustRound(id)))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(MinBid), minNextBid(&round{}))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(105), minNextBid(&round{bid: 100}))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(107), minNextBid(&round{bid: 101}), "the raise rounds up")

	uassert.True(t, printable("Cheers!", maxToastLen))
	for _, bad := range []string{"", strings.Repeat("a", maxToastLen+1), "two\nlines", "bad\xffutf8", "bell\x07"} {
		uassert.False(t, printable(bad, maxToastLen))
	}
	uassert.PanicsWithMessage(t, cur, "unknown round 999999", func() { mustRound(999999) })

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(seller))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "the round is not settled yet", func() { Reclaim(cross(cur), id) })

	// Close it out. Running the job is open to everyone, the seller included.
	testing.SkipHeights(61)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(seller))
	registry.Exec(cross(cur), JobOf(id))
	uassert.True(t, Settled(id))
}

// The callback settles only rounds of this realm, only for the registry, and
// only once they are closed.
func TestSettleJobGuards(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(seller))
	sending(LampFee)
	id := Open(cross(cur), "Guarded", 60)
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	job := JobOf(id)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(lighter))
	uassert.True(t, settleJob(cross(cur), job) != nil, "a user calling the callback")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewCodeRealm("gno.land/r/test/impostor"))
	uassert.True(t, settleJob(cross(cur), job) != nil, "another realm calling the callback")
	uassert.False(t, Settled(id))

	// Another realm posts this realm's callback as a job of its own. The job
	// id is not one this realm posted, so it settles nothing.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewCodeRealm("gno.land/r/test/attacker"))
	hijack := registry.Register(cross(cur), "hijack", 0, 10, registry.MinReward, settleJob)
	testing.IssueCoins(chain.PackageAddress(registry.Path()), chain.Coins{{denom, registry.MinReward}})
	registry.Credit(cross(cur), hijack, registry.MinReward)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewCodeRealm(registry.Path()))
	err := settleJob(cross(cur), hijack)
	uassert.True(t, err != nil && strings.Contains(err.Error(), "not a job of this realm"))
	uassert.False(t, Settled(id))

	// The registry itself, but before closing time.
	err = settleJob(cross(cur), job)
	uassert.True(t, err != nil && strings.Contains(err.Error(), "is still open"))

	testing.SkipHeights(13)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(lighter))
	registry.Exec(cross(cur), job)
	uassert.True(t, Settled(id))
}

	botAddr   = testutils.TestAddress("bot")
	alice     = testutils.TestAddress("alice")
	bob       = testutils.TestAddress("bob")

// reset gives each test fresh state with a known admin.
func reset() {
	admin = adminAddr
	attesters = avl.NewTree()
	attesters.Set(string(adminAddr), true)
	requests = avl.NewTree()
	openByRequester = avl.NewTree()
	openRequests = avl.NewTree()

	records = avl.NewTree()
	byAuthor = avl.NewTree()
	families = avl.NewTree()
	disputes = avl.NewTree()
	recent = nil
	totalFindings, totalProven = 0, 0
}

// testing.SetRealm applies to the frame that calls it, so it is called
// inline right before each crossing call, never from a helper.

func hash(c string) string { return strings.Repeat(c, 64) }

// attest posts an attestation as the bot (which must be an attester).
func attest(cur realm, pkgpath, report, findings string, unverified int) {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(botAddr))
	Attest(cross(cur), pkgpath, hash("a"), "0.1.0", hash("b"), "master.1+f0f9c70", report, "ipfs://bafyexample", findings, 0, 0, unverified)
}

func addBot(cur realm) {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(adminAddr))
	AddAttester(cross(cur), botAddr)
}

func TestScoreFormula(t *testing.T) {
	f := func(rule, sev, label string) Finding {
		return Finding{Rule: rule, Severity: sev, Label: label, File: "a.gno", Line: 1}
	}
	cases := []struct {
		name    string
		fs      []Finding
		deps    Deps
		score   int
		grade   string
		verdict string
	}{
		{"clean", nil, Deps{}, 100, "A", VerdictClear},
		{"proven critical", []Finding{f("B05", SeverityCritical, LabelProven)}, Deps{}, 60, "C", VerdictNotRecommended},
		{"proven high", []Finding{f("B01", SeverityHigh, LabelProven)}, Deps{}, 75, "B", VerdictNotRecommended},
		{"high warning", []Finding{f("B01", SeverityHigh, LabelNotReproduced)}, Deps{}, 90, "A", VerdictReview},
		{"critical static warning", []Finding{f("B03", SeverityCritical, LabelStaticWarning)}, Deps{}, 85, "B", VerdictReview},
		{"medium only", []Finding{f("B04", SeverityMedium, LabelStaticWarning)}, Deps{}, 95, "A", VerdictClear},
		{"mixed with deps", []Finding{
			f("B05", SeverityCritical, LabelProven),      // 40
			f("B01", SeverityHigh, LabelNotReproduced),   // 10
			f("B04", SeverityMedium, LabelStaticWarning), // 5
		}, Deps{DirectAtRisk: 1, IndirectAtRisk: 1, Unverified: 1}, 28, "F", VerdictNotRecommended}, // 100-55-10-5-2
		{"unverified capped at 10", nil, Deps{Unverified: 7}, 90, "A", VerdictClear},
		{"floor at zero", []Finding{
			f("B05", SeverityCritical, LabelProven),
			f("B05", SeverityCritical, LabelProven),
			f("B05", SeverityCritical, LabelProven),
		}, Deps{}, 0, "F", VerdictNotRecommended},
		{"grade D", []Finding{f("B01", SeverityHigh, LabelProven), f("B01", SeverityHigh, LabelProven), f("B04", SeverityMedium, LabelStaticWarning)}, Deps{}, 45, "D", VerdictNotRecommended},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		score, grade, verdict := ScoreFor(c.fs, c.deps)
		if score != c.score || grade != c.grade || verdict != c.verdict {
			t.Errorf("%s: got %d %s %s, want %d %s %s", c.name, score, grade, verdict, c.score, c.grade, c.verdict)
		}
	}
}

func TestRequestScan(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()

package mandate

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

const base = "/r/g1llc3lq3zmjtjdk29dk52munrzxt5ne746cl7r8/mandate"

func has(t *testing.T, page, want, what string) {
	t.Helper()
	if !strings.Contains(page, want) {
		t.Fatalf("%s: page does not contain %q\n--- page ---\n%s", what, want, page)
	}
}

func hasNot(t *testing.T, page, bad, what string) {
	t.Helper()
	if strings.Contains(page, bad) {
		t.Fatalf("%s: page must not contain %q\n--- page ---\n%s", what, bad, page)
	}
}

// renders calls Render and fails the test (instead of crashing) on a panic.
func renders(t *testing.T, path string) string {
	t.Helper()
	var out string
	if r := revive(func() { out = Render(path) }); r != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Render(%q) panicked: %v", path, r)
	}
	return out
}

func TestRenderEmpty(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()
	home := renders(t, "")
	has(t, home, "# Mandate", "title")
	has(t, home, "It is direct debit, not escrow.", "honest limit: not escrow")
	has(t, home, "0.1 GNOT", "fee allowance")
	has(t, home, "At most 16 mandates per wallet", "16 sessions")
	has(t, home, "Revoke any time.", "revoke")
	has(t, home, "nothing will ever be deployed there", "sub-path rule")
	has(t, home, "| 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 GNOT |", "empty totals")
	has(t, home, "No plan has been paid for in its current or last period.", "empty list")
	has(t, home, "Built on [gno.land](https://gno.land)", "footer")
	has(t, renders(t, "plans"), "No plans on this page.", "empty all-plans page")
	for _, p := range []string{
		"x", "plan", "plan/", "plan/1", "plan/abc", "plan/-1", "plan/1/2", "payer/", "payer/g1bad", "payee/xyz",
		"help/x", "../help", "plan/18446744073709551616",
	} {
		has(t, renders(t, p), "# Not found", "not found: "+p)
	}
	has(t, renders(t, "payer/"+payer.String()), "No mandates on this page.", "empty payer")
	has(t, renders(t, "payee/"+payee.String()), "No plans from this address.", "empty payee")
}

func TestRenderHelp(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()
	h := renders(t, "help")
	net := "-broadcast -chainid onyx-1 -remote https://rpc.onyx.testnets.gno.land:443"
	has(t, h, "gnokey maketx call -pkgpath gno.land/r/g1llc3lq3zmjtjdk29dk52munrzxt5ne746cl7r8/mandate -func Offer -args \"TITLE\" -args 1000000 -args 604800 -gas-fee 100000ugnot -gas-wanted 60000000 "+net+" YOUR_KEY", "offer command")
	has(t, h, "the joiner included, are refused", "format characters explained")
	has(t, h, "-func SetCollectorKey -args GPUB_OF_COLLECTOR_KEY", "collector key command")
	has(t, h, "-func Pull -send AMOUNTugnot -master SUPPORTER_ADDRESS -gas-fee 20000ugnot -gas-wanted 20000000 "+net+" COLLECTOR_KEY", "pull command")
	has(t, h, "gnokey maketx session create -pubkey COLLECTOR_GPUB -allow-paths vm/exec:gno.land/r/g1llc3lq3zmjtjdk29dk52munrzxt5ne746cl7r8/mandate -spend-limit PRICE_PLUS_100000ugnot -spend-period PERIOD_SECONDS -expires-at UNIX_TIME", "session command")
	has(t, h, "gnokey maketx session revoke -pubkey COLLECTOR_GPUB", "revoke")
	has(t, h, "-func Cancel -args YOUR_ADDRESS -args COLLECTOR_ADDRESS", "cancel")
	has(t, h, "gnokey query auth/accounts/PAYER/session/COLLECTOR_ADDRESS -remote https://rpc.onyx.testnets.gno.land:443", "session check")
	has(t, h, "PaidThrough(address(\"PAYER\"), PLAN_ID)", "qeval check")
	hasNot(t, h, "127.0.0.1", "no local node")
	hasNot(t, h, "-chainid dev", "no dev chain")
	// Every gnokey line that talks to a node names onyx-1 or the Onyx RPC.
	for _, line := range strings.Split(h, "\n") {
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "gnokey maketx") {
			has(t, line, net, "pinned: "+line)
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "gnokey query") {
			has(t, line, "-remote https://rpc.onyx.testnets.gno.land:443", "pinned: "+line)
		}
	}
}

func TestRenderPages(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()
	pid := offer(cur, payee, "Weekly coffee", gnot, 7*day)
	demo := offer(cur, payee, "Demo plan", gnot, 60)
	p, _ := GetPlan(pid)

	// No collector key yet: no subscribe commands.
	pp := renders(t, "plan/1")
	has(t, pp, "# Plan #1: Weekly coffee", "plan title")
	has(t, pp, "**1 GNOT every week** to ["+payee.String()+"]("+base+":payee/"+payee.String()+")", "price line")
	has(t, pp, "has not published a collector key", "no key")
	hasNot(t, pp, "session create", "no command without key")
	has(t, renders(t, "plan/2"), "a test plan: the period is under a day", "short period flagged")
	hasNot(t, pp, "a test plan", "week plan not flagged")

	setKey(cur, payee, gpubA)
	subscribe(cur, payer, pid, sessA, now()+30*day)
	subscribe(cur, payer2, pid, sessB, now()+30*day)
	pullOK(payer, sessA, gnot)
	cancel(cur, payer2, payer2, sessB)

	pp = renders(t, "plan/1")
	exp := itoa(now() + 365*day)
	has(t, pp, "gnokey maketx session create -pubkey "+gpubA+" -allow-paths vm/exec:gno.land/r/g1llc3lq3zmjtjdk29dk52munrzxt5ne746cl7r8/mandate -spend-limit 1100000ugnot -spend-period 604800 -expires-at "+exp+" -gas-fee 100000ugnot -gas-wanted 60000000 -broadcast -chainid onyx-1 -remote https://rpc.onyx.testnets.gno.land:443 YOUR_KEY", "session create")
	has(t, pp, "gnokey maketx call -pkgpath gno.land/r/g1llc3lq3zmjtjdk29dk52munrzxt5ne746cl7r8/mandate -func Subscribe -args 1 -args "+sessA.String()+" -args "+exp+" -gas-fee 100000ugnot", "subscribe command")
	has(t, pp, "at most 1.1 GNOT every week", "cap in words")
	has(t, pp, "1 payment in the current period", "paid count")
	has(t, pp, "0 active mandates have not paid yet", "unpaid count")
	has(t, pp, "| ["+short(payer)+"]("+base+":payer/"+payer.String()+") |", "active supporter listed")
	hasNot(t, pp, short(payer2), "cancelled supporter not listed")
	has(t, pp, "1 payment, 1 GNOT in total", "plan totals")
	uassert.Equal(t, uint64(2), demo)
	_ = p

	pr := renders(t, "payer/"+payer.String())
	has(t, pr, "## Mandate 1: [plan #1 Weekly coffee]("+base+":plan/1)", "mandate heading")
	has(t, pr, "Status here: **active**", "status")
	has(t, pr, "gnokey maketx session revoke -pubkey "+gpubA+" -gas-fee 100000ugnot -gas-wanted 60000000 -broadcast -chainid onyx-1 -remote https://rpc.onyx.testnets.gno.land:443 YOUR_KEY", "revoke command")
	has(t, pr, "-func Cancel -args "+payer.String()+" -args "+sessA.String()+" -gas-fee", "cancel command")
	has(t, pr, "Payments: 1, 1 GNOT in total", "payer totals")
	// Unknown session public key: show how to find it.
	setKey(cur, payee, gpubB)
	subscribe(cur, payer2, demo, sessA, now()+day)
	p2 := renders(t, "payer/"+payer2.String())
	has(t, p2, "Status here: **cancelled**", "cancelled mandate")
	has(t, p2, "gnokey query auth/accounts/"+payer2.String()+"/sessions -remote https://rpc.onyx.testnets.gno.land:443", "list sessions")

	pe := renders(t, "payee/"+payee.String())
	has(t, pe, "| 2 | 1 | 1 GNOT |", "payee totals")
	has(t, pe, "Collector key: `"+sessB.String()+"` (`"+gpubB+"`)", "collector key shown")
	has(t, pe, "| [#1 Weekly coffee]("+base+":plan/1) | 1 GNOT every week | 1 / 0 | 1 |", "plan row")

	home := renders(t, "")
	has(t, home, "| 2 | 3 | 1 | 1 GNOT |", "home totals")
	has(t, renders(t, "plans"), "| [#2 Demo plan]("+base+":plan/2) | 1 GNOT every minute |", "all plans list")
}

// Titles cannot inject Markdown, HTML, links, mentions or math anywhere they
// are shown (plan page heading, payer heading, home and payee tables).
func TestRenderInjection(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()
	setKey(cur, payee, gpubA)
	evil := []string{
		"# heading",
		"[click](https://evil.example)",
		"![img](https://evil.example/x.png)",
		"<script>alert(1)</script>",
		"a | b | c",
		"$x^2$ and $$y$$",
		"@moul look",
		"g1jg8mtutu9khhfwc4nxmuhcpftf0pajdhfvsqf5 leading address",
		"pay g1jg8mtutu9khhfwc4nxmuhcpftf0pajdhfvsqf5 now",
		"`code` and ```fence",
		"*bold* _it_ ~~s~~",
		"> quote",
		"<https://auto.link>",
		"& A",
	}
	for _, title := range evil {
		pid := offer(cur, payee, title, gnot, day)
		subscribe(cur, payer, pid, sessA, now()+day)
		cancel(cur, payer, payer, sessA)
		pages := map[string]string{
			"plan":  renders(t, "plan/"+utoa(pid)),
			"payer": renders(t, "payer/"+payer.String()),
			"payee": renders(t, "payee/"+payee.String()),
			"home":  renders(t, ""),
			"plans": renders(t, "plans"),
		}
		for name, pg := range pages {
			what := name + " " + title
			hasNot(t, pg, "](https://evil", what)
			hasNot(t, pg, "<script>", what)
			hasNot(t, pg, "\n# heading", what)
			hasNot(t, strings.ReplaceAll(pg, `\$`, ""), "$", what) // every $ escaped
			hasNot(t, strings.ReplaceAll(pg, `\@`, ""), "@", what) // every @ escaped
			hasNot(t, pg, " g1jg8mtutu9khhfwc4nxmuhcpftf0pajdhfvsqf5", what)
			hasNot(t, stripKnown(pg), "<", what) // no raw "<": no HTML, no autolink
			hasNot(t, pg, "& A", what)
			if name == "plans" || name == "payee" { // tables: a "|" must not split the cell
				hasNot(t, pg, "| b |", what)
			}
		}
		has(t, pages["plan"], ": "+esc(title)+"\n", "escaped heading")
	}
	uassert.Equal(t, "\\# heading", esc("# heading"))
	uassert.Equal(t, "g1jg8mtutu9khhfwc4nxmuhcpftf0pajdhfvsqf5", esc("g1jg8mtutu9khhfwc4nxmuhcpftf0pajdhfvsqf5"))
	uassert.Equal(t, "a g1x", gnowebSafe("a g1x"))
	uassert.Equal(t, `\$1`, gnowebSafe("$1"))
	uassert.Equal(t, `\@x`, gnowebSafe("@x"))
}

// stripKnown removes escaped "<" and the realm's own placeholders in code
// spans, so any "<" left would come from a title.
func stripKnown(pg string) string {
	for _, k := range []string{`\<`, "`/r/g1llc3lq3zmjtjdk29dk52munrzxt5ne746cl7r8/mandate:payer/<your address>`", "`gnokey maketx session revoke -pubkey <its gpub1 key> ... YOUR_KEY`"} {
		pg = strings.ReplaceAll(pg, k, "")
	}
	return pg
}

func TestRenderPaging(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()
	setKey(cur, payee, gpubA)
	for i := 0; i < 21; i++ {
		offer(cur, payee, "Plan "+itoa(int64(i+1)), gnot, day)
	}
	for i := 0; i < 21; i++ {
		who := testutils.TestAddress("md_r" + itoa(int64(i)))
		subscribe(cur, who, 1, sessA, now()+day)
	}
	// all subscribers pay once; plan 1's supporters then span two pages of 20
	for i := 0; i < 21; i++ {
		pullOK(testutils.TestAddress("md_r"+itoa(int64(i))), sessA, gnot)
	}
	all := renders(t, "plans")
	has(t, all, "[Next page]("+base+":plans?page=2)", "all plans next")
	h2 := renders(t, "plans?page=2")
	has(t, h2, "[Previous page]("+base+":plans?page=1)", "all plans previous")
	has(t, h2, "[#1 Plan 1]("+base+":plan/1)", "oldest on page 2")
	has(t, renders(t, ""), "[#1 Plan 1]("+base+":plan/1) | 1 GNOT every day |", "paid plan on home")
	plan := renders(t, "plan/1")
	has(t, plan, "21 payments in the current period", "count")
	has(t, plan, "| ["+short(testutils.TestAddress("md_r20"))+"]", "newest first")
	has(t, plan, "[More supporters]("+base+":plan/1?from=0)", "plan cursor")
	has(t, renders(t, "plan/1?from=0"), "| ["+short(testutils.TestAddress("md_r0"))+"]", "oldest on the next page")
	// PayingSupporters pages the same way: 20 newest, then the oldest one
	ps, next := PayingSupporters(1, -1)
	uassert.Equal(t, PageSize, len(ps))
	uassert.Equal(t, testutils.TestAddress("md_r20").String(), ps[0].Payer.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, next)
	ps, next = PayingSupporters(1, next)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, len(ps))
	uassert.Equal(t, testutils.TestAddress("md_r0").String(), ps[0].Payer.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, -1, next)
	has(t, renders(t, "payee/"+payee.String()), "[Next page]("+base+":payee/"+payee.String()+"?page=2)", "payee next")
}
